title: The Business Growth Score
subtitle: Answer 14 quick questions and get a personalized dashboard showing exactly where your business stands — and what to fix first.
durationNote: Takes about 3 minutes · Free · No jargon

dimensions.label: Brand Clarity
dimensions.blurb: How clear and consistent your business looks and sounds to a stranger.

notes.low: Right now, customers likely can't tell what you offer or why you're different — that costs you sales before any marketing even starts. The good news: this is the fastest thing to fix.
notes.mid: You have the pieces of a brand, but they're not working together yet. Tightening your message and using one consistent look everywhere will make everything else you do more effective.
notes.high: Your brand is clear and consistent — a real asset. Keep it tight as you grow, and make sure every new channel uses the same look and message.

quickWin.low: Write one sentence: "I help [who] get [result] without [pain]" — and put it everywhere.
quickWin.mid: Pick one logo, two colors, two fonts — then update all your profiles to match in one afternoon.
quickWin.high: Turn your brand into templates so every new post or page stays on-brand automatically.

dimensions.label: Online Presence
dimensions.blurb: Whether customers can find you — on Google, on their phones, and now in AI tools like ChatGPT.

notes.low: If customers can't find you online, you don't exist for most of them — over 80% of people check a business online before buying. A simple professional site changes this fast.
notes.mid: You're findable, but you're leaking trust: an outdated site or thin Google presence makes customers hesitate. A refresh plus proper Google/AI setup would put you ahead of most local competitors.
notes.high: Strong presence — you're ahead of the pack. The next frontier is AI search: making sure ChatGPT and Google's AI can read and recommend your business.

quickWin.low: Claim your free Google Business Profile today — it takes 30 minutes and makes you findable.
quickWin.mid: Open your website on your phone and fix the three most annoying things you see.
quickWin.high: Ask ChatGPT what it knows about your business — then fill the gaps it reveals.

dimensions.label: Getting Customers
dimensions.blurb: How reliably new inquiries come in — and whether any of them slip through the cracks.

notes.low: Your business currently depends on luck and word of mouth. That feels fine until it goes quiet. Building one reliable channel — plus a way to capture every inquiry — is the priority.
notes.mid: Customers are coming, but inconsistently, and some inquiries likely slip away unanswered. A simple system that saves every lead and a steady content rhythm would smooth out the ups and downs.
notes.high: You have real customer flow. Now it's about scale: more channels, faster follow-up, and content that keeps working for you while you sleep.

quickWin.low: Set up one simple contact form that saves every inquiry in one place — never rely on DMs alone.
quickWin.mid: Block 2 hours weekly to batch-create your posts — consistency beats brilliance.
quickWin.high: Add one new channel this quarter (blog, email list, or short video) and measure it.

dimensions.label: Systems & AI
dimensions.blurb: How much of your week gets eaten by repetitive work that tools could do for you.

notes.low: You're the bottleneck in your own business — hours go into work that free AI tools could do in minutes. Every week this continues is a week of growth you're giving away.
notes.mid: You've started using tools, but there's still a lot of copy-paste in your week. Connecting the pieces (forms → customer list → follow-up) would give you hours back.
notes.high: You run a modern operation — tools and AI are doing real work for you. The next level is automation that runs daily without you touching it.

quickWin.low: Pick your most annoying weekly task and ask ChatGPT to do it — today, free.
quickWin.mid: Move your customer list out of your head/chats into one simple tool this week.
quickWin.high: Automate one full workflow end-to-end — from inquiry to follow-up — and let it run.

grades.label: Foundation Stage
grades.summary: You're at the very start — which means every improvement from here has a big impact. Your score isn't a judgment; it's a map. Focus on the two lowest areas below and you'll feel the difference within weeks.

grades.label: Momentum Building
grades.summary: You've built real foundations — now the gaps are what's holding you back. The pattern below shows exactly where effort is leaking. Fix the lowest bar first; it's usually the cheapest win.

grades.label: Growth Ready
grades.summary: You're ahead of most small businesses. What's left isn't about working harder — it's about systems and consistency doing the work for you. The notes below show where to focus.

grades.label: Scale Mode
grades.summary: Impressive — you run a tighter operation than the vast majority of small businesses. Your opportunities now are automation and reach: making growth happen without more of your hours.
